datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Haiti administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases (IPC 1-5 scale) aggregated by geographic area and time period, reflecting underlying food security hazards and population vulnerability.
